Scenario fixture: a11ycore-aria-hidden-body

01 — FAIL: the <body> element itself carries aria-hidden="true"

This hides the entire page from assistive technologies. This is a whole-document check (evaluates document.body directly), so only one outcome is possible per page — the PASS case is simply any page whose <body> has no aria-hidden="true" (already covered by the inline unit tests in this rule's .test.js file; not worth a second fixture file).
